letter:
My dearest Liza, my jaan, my endless sunshine,  
Every sunrise in Dubai and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad reminds me how lucky I am to share this beautiful chaos with you. Your laugh is my favorite soundtrack, your smile my daily sunrise. As we wander between skyscrapers and spice markets, I fall deeper in love with the wonderful woman you are—playful, kind, and forever my cutie. Thank you for turning every ordinary moment into a magical memory. I love you more than words can hold, today and always.
poem:
Across the dunes or by the river’s flow,  
Your love’s the compass that I always know.  
In every city, in each whispered sigh,  
Together we’ll dance, forever you and I.
